title: The Agent Asks First
body: The Agent Asks First Some things an agent should not do on its own. Saving a routine that will run every morning as you, saving a new skill into its own memory, forgetting a note: BxAgents makes the run stop at those tools, shows the person what the agent is about to do, and carries on only when the person says so. title: The Agent Definition - Agent.yml
body: The Agent Definition - Agent.yml Agent.yml is the only required file in a BxAgents project (beside the instructions it points at). It is plain settings - a name, a model, and any optional extras - and the build turns it into a real BX AI agent . No code needed. name: my-agent description: A helpful assistant model: openai/gpt-5 instructions: | You are a helpful assistant. That is a complete agent.…

title: The Build Pipeline
body: The Build Pipeline bxAgents build runs a fixed sequence of phases, once, producing a plain ColdBox application laid out like the ColdBox BoxLang application template : the code in .build/app , the web root in .build/public . title: vault
body: The vault An agent that connects to Gmail, a ticket system or any API needs a key or a login. title: What Is BxAgents?
body: What Is BxAgents? Most agent frameworks wire tools, skills, routes and schedules together at request time , on every boot. BxAgents does the opposite: bxAgents build runs discovery, validation and code generation exactly once , producing a plain ColdBox application in .build/ , laid out like the ColdBox BoxLang template: the code in app/ , the web root in public/ .
